main_text.p: roductis longum nunc complés traßibus auras. At tu Musarum dulcissima cura, Tagauti, arnasi doctus diuinum carmen in hortis, t totum Aonio prolutus nectare pectus, ic Verbis numeros, numeris sic Verba rependis, t pariter mentem mulcens lectoris, & aures, incipitem miretur strum mage saepe reliquas: Et quanto Volucres superat philomela canoras: Hac tanto cantata tibi philomela canoros AEternum Vates manfuro carmine vincat. Viue igitur noua, Viue noui philomela poeta: Sic tibi Pierides faueant, & docti Apollo, Applaudensque tibi Satu genus omne canorum, Concedat palmam noctesque diesque canenti.
main_text.head: IOANNIS TAGAVTII Parisiensis, Lauisannæ Mathematicas disciplinas profitentis, & immatura morte Geneuæ sublati, poema: quod Philomelam inscripsit, Bezæ suo dicatum.
main_text.p: QVid dignum te, Beza, canam, mihi quando sonoris Sponte sua numeris nunc Verba poetica surgunt? Nunc quando Virides nos afflauere Thalia, Vltro Vere nouo, dum floribus omnia Vernis

page.notes: The first line is cut at the left edge of the scan, so its opening letters are a fragment. "arnasi" and "Verbis" in the verse are partly unclear at the edge; "Serbis" reads as Verbis from the shape of the letter. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The verse is set in italic with several words in bold or heavier type, which is not marked.
